title: A lipid-binding protein in black-legged tick saliva selectively recognizes Borrelia burgdorferi lipids
authors: Weirui Olivia Shi; Taylor MacMackin-Ingle; Mia Wong Perez; Wendell P. Griffith; Liao Y. Chen; J. Seshu; Robert Renthal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜱虫唾液脂质结合蛋白TULIP2与伯氏疏螺旋体脂质的识别，虽含分子动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-脂质互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: A proteomic analysis of Ixodes scapularis nymph saliva identified 252 proteins, including six tubular lipid-binding proteins (TULIPs). Comparing nymphs fed on mice that were uninfected or infected with Borrelia burgdorferi , twelve salivary proteins showed significant differences in the amounts detected, including XP_040079658.2, which we refer to as TULIP2. Considering the known immunity-related functions of some TULIPs, we expressed and purified TULIP2 from Escherichia coli and analyzed its interaction with B. burgdorferi lipids. The purification of TULIP2 from E. coli presented many obstacles, due to insolubility, which is consistent with previous reports from studies of other TULIP family members. The binding results showed specificity for B. burgdorferi lipids, with evidence for cholesteryl β-galactoside as a major binding target. Molecular modeling of TULIP2 did not show any strong lipid binding sites. We used molecular dynamics simulation of TULIP2 to explore its conformational landscape by thermal unfolding. The earliest unfolding intermediate opened a hydrophobic pocket to which cholesteryl β-galactoside was predicted to bind strongly. We propose that a specific lipid bilayer interaction with TULIP2 triggers the opening of the ligand-binding site.
abstract_zh: 对肩突蜱（Ixodes scapularis）若虫唾液的蛋白质组学分析鉴定出252种蛋白质，其中包括六种管状脂质结合蛋白（TULIPs）。比较在未感染或感染伯氏疏螺旋体（Borrelia burgdorferi）的小鼠上取食的若虫，十二种唾液蛋白在检测量上显示出显著差异，包括XP_040079658.2，我们将其称为TULIP2。鉴于某些TULIPs已知的免疫相关功能，我们从大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）中表达并纯化了TULIP2，并分析了其与伯氏疏螺旋体脂质的相互作用。由于不溶性，从大肠杆菌中纯化TULIP2面临许多障碍，这与先前对其他TULIP家族成员研究的报道一致。结合结果显示对伯氏疏螺旋体脂质具有特异性，并有证据表明胆固醇β-半乳糖苷是主要结合靶标。TULIP2的分子建模未显示任何强脂质结合位点。我们使用TULIP2的分子动力学模拟，通过热解折叠探索其构象景观。最早的解折叠中间体打开了一个疏水口袋，预测胆固醇β-半乳糖苷能强效结合于此。我们提出，与TULIP2的特异性脂质双层相互作用触发了配体结合位点的开放。
